content: The United States’ execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed, anonymous officials from the Defense Department told the BBC and Associated Press. The planned execution of Nidal Hasan, the former US Army major convicted of killing 13 people at the Texas military base, was announced this week. He is scheduled to be executed by firing squad on December 3rd at 2PM ET. The Verge contacted YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Meta, Rumble, and Kick to ask if they plan to allow the livestream to be aired on their platforms. None responded before publication. “We’ll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it’s public, because people need to understand that there’s serious consequences for these types of things,” US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said in an interview with Real America’s Voice.

chineseContent: 美国国防部匿名官员告诉英国广播公司和美联社，美国对胡德堡枪手的处决将进行现场直播。本周宣布计划处决前美国陆军少校尼达尔·哈桑 (Nidal Hasan)，他因在德克萨斯州军事基地杀害 13 人而被定罪。他定于美国东部时间 12 月 3 日下午 2 点被行刑队处决。 The Verge 联系了 YouTube、Twitch、TikTok、Meta、Rumble 和 Kick，询问他们是否计划允许直播在他们的平台上播出。在发布之前没有人做出回应。美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯在接受“真实美国之声”采访时表示：“我们将确保人们能够观看它，它是公开的，因为人们需要了解此类事件会带来严重后果。”
